description: Defines the AdbHandler class responsible for handling ADB communication over WebRTC streaming in the cuttlefish project. It declares methods for message handling, thread management, and socket communication, and includes relevant external dependencies.

classes.name: AdbHandler
classes.description: A class that manages ADB communication over a socket, including message handling and threading.

methods.name: AdbHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with ADB host:port and a callback to send data to the client.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages received over ADB.

methods.name: ReadLoop
methods.description: Internal method that runs in a separate thread to read data from the socket.
